title: Extremely disappointed.
text: Extremely disappointed.. For a pillow that retails for a little under $50, I am disappointed. I received this Stone & Beam pillow for an honest review. I didn’t mind the assembly (unwrap the pillow and stuff it in the cover), which is pretty simple, but the quality was lacking. The fabric (a mixture of linen and viscose) looks ok but seems thin and not durable at all. The design on the front, three wavy lines are cute but look a little unfinished or rough looking. I guess the whole pillow seems like something I would have made, kind of amateurish.  What I do like is the color (flax) or tan. It is neutral enough to match a variety of sofas, chairs or comforters. Colors like maroon or navy would make this pillow pop. In the past, I have tried Stone & Beam products and found them to be great, so I won’t let this “miss” turn me away from the brand. In conclusion, when I consider the price and quality, I give this pillow 3 stars.
